entries.title: Psalms 85:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.>> LORD, You have been favorable to Your land; You have brought back the captivity of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 85:2
segments: You have forgiven the iniquity of Your people; You have covered all their sin. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 85:3
segments: You have taken away all Your wrath; You have turned from the fierceness of Your anger.

entries.title: Psalms 85:4
segments: Restore us, O God of our salvation, And cause Your anger toward us to cease.

entries.title: Psalms 85:5
segments: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You prolong Your anger to all generations?

entries.title: Psalms 85:6
segments: Will You not revive us again, That Your people may rejoice in You?

entries.title: Psalms 85:7
segments: Show us Your mercy, LORD, And grant us Your salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 85:8
segments: ¶I will hear what God the LORD will speak, For He will speak peace To His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly.

entries.title: Psalms 85:9
segments: Surely His salvation [is] near to those who fear Him, That glory may dwell in our land.

entries.title: Psalms 85:10
segments: Mercy and truth have met together; Righteousness and peace have kissed.

entries.title: Psalms 85:11
segments: Truth shall spring out of the earth, And righteousness shall look down from heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 85:12
segments: Yes, the LORD will give [what is] good; And our land will yield its increase.

entries.title: Psalms 85:13
segments: Righteousness will go before Him, And shall make His footsteps [our] pathway.
